name: Collection
line: An image-first museum page: Hooke's engraving of cork cells hangs on a warm-grey wall beside the headline with its object label; the explorers are presented as permanent galleries, and a calm horizontal row of Redouté, Haeckel and Bradbury plates carries their museum labels.
notes: Wix Madefor covers Cyrillic but not Han. Oxblood is used once as a full band (Code Against Cancer) and otherwise only for Group 1 tags and hovers. The object row scrolls sideways with scroll snap; on desktop two round arrow buttons step through it. Object labels quote only credits.json (maker, title, book and dates, licence).
